policy: These substantive project repositories remain in the 95-project development register without a separate standalone seller-side price. Digital Twin Core has no committed implementation baseline. LEARNPIANO is economically represented by TA-IP-086 Interactive Piano Learning Platform, and the distinct PLANTELOGIA lineage is economically represented within TA-IP-085 Adaptive Systems Intelligence Platform. This prevents duplicate economic counting while preserving project-level identity.

projects.name: Digital Twin Core
projects.description: Reserved Digital Twin Core project. At the current repository state, no committed implementation baseline exists and no software maturity claim is made.
projects.pricingDisposition: No standalone seller-side price: no committed implementation baseline exists.

projects.name: LEARNPIANO — Piano Paradise
projects.description: Local-first piano learning, performance and production software with browser-based practice, MIDI and audio workflows, adaptive coaching and repository-owned validation.
projects.pricingDisposition: No duplicate seller-side price: current economic work product is represented by TA-IP-086 Interactive Piano Learning Platform.

projects.name: PLANTELOGIA Intelligence Platform
projects.description: Evidence-governed intelligence and policy-runtime software with persistent evidence, audit, policy, delegated-authority and provenance foundations, maintained as a distinct PLANTELOGIA lineage project.
projects.pricingDisposition: No duplicate seller-side price: current economic work product is represented within TA-IP-085 Adaptive Systems Intelligence Platform.
